title: Mock exam in the style of ZIMSEC O-Level History Paper 1 (History of Zimbabwe)
description: A full-length practice paper modelled on ZIMSEC O-Level History Paper 1 (History of Zimbabwe): a choice of 25-mark structured questions on Zimbabwe from pre-colonial times to after independence, including one source-based question, answer any four, 2 hours, 100 marks. This practice paper offers ten questions where the real paper offers 22. This is an original practice paper written for this platform in the style of the real examination. It is not an official paper, and its questions are not past-paper questions.
instructions:
Answer **any four** questions. You have 2 hours.

- Each question is worth 25 marks; part (b) and part (c) ask you to explain and to evaluate. Use precise dates, names and examples.
- If you answer more than four questions, your best four count.
- Written answers cannot be marked automatically: after you submit, each one is shown with our mark scheme so that you can mark your own answer honestly. Multiple-choice, numerical and short factual answers are marked automatically.

The format follows Paper 1 as described in the 2015-2022 syllabus; the part marks are our convention. Check the instructions on your own examination papers.
